## 2. Load and concatenate raw data

Participant ID is everything before the first `_` in the filename (e.g. `002`, `n2026`, `p7259`).

Two PsychoPy experiment versions are handled here:

-   **v1 (pilot):** momentary and stimulus valence each collected on two alternating sliders (A and B). Columns: `momentary_valence_slider_A/B.response`, `stim_valence_slider_A/B.response`.
-   **v2 (July update):** single combined affect screen; one slider each. Columns: `momentary_valence_slider.response`, `stim_valence_slider.response`.

Row-type identifiers (e.g. `pre_baseline_ratings.momentary_arousal_slider.response`) are **unchanged** between versions. Valence extraction uses a triple coalesce: A → B → single, so both formats work in one pipeline. A `data_version` column records which format each participant contributed.

```{r load-data}

data_dir <- (psychopy_data_dir)

csv_files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(csv_files) == 0) stop("No CSV files found in: ", data_dir)

# Exclude old pilot IDs by filename (these were initial pilots I ran on myself, but they do not include the emotion label questions)

exclude_ids <- c("001", "002")
pattern     <- paste(exclude_ids, collapse = "|")
csv_files   <- csv_files[!grepl(pattern, basename(csv_files), ignore.case = TRUE)]
cat("Files after exclusion:", length(csv_files), "\n")
print(basename(csv_files))

# Split into task files vs biometrics files — different schemas, don't bind together
task_files       <- csv_files[!grepl("_biometrics\\.csv$", csv_files)]
biometrics_files <- csv_files[ grepl("_biometrics\\.csv$", csv_files)]

# Helper: extract participant ID as everything before the first "_"
extract_pid <- function(path) tolower(sub("_.*", "", basename(path)))

# Loader: reads a set of same-schema CSVs and row-binds them
load_csv_set <- function(files) {
  map_dfr(files, function(path) {
    df <- read_csv(path,
                   show_col_types = FALSE,
                   col_types      = cols(.default = col_character()),  # read all as char to avoid type conflicts
                   name_repair    = "minimal",
                   locale         = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))
    names(df)[1] <- gsub("^\ufeff", "", names(df)[1])  # strip BOM
    df$participant_id <- extract_pid(path)
    df
  }) |>
    type_convert(guess_integer = FALSE)  # re-infer types after binding
}

raw_task       <- load_csv_set(task_files)

raw_biometrics <- load_csv_set(biometrics_files)

cat("Task rows          :", nrow(raw_task), "\n")
cat("Task participants  :", paste(sort(unique(raw_task$participant_id)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Biometrics rows    :", nrow(raw_biometrics), "\n")
cat("Biometrics parts   :", paste(sort(unique(raw_biometrics$participant_id)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 3. Helper functions

```{r helpers}
# Coalesce two columns into one numeric value
coalesce_val <- function(a, b) coalesce(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(a)),
                                        suppressWarnings(as.numeric(b)))

# Triple coalesce: try A, then B, then a single-slider column.
# Old format (v1): A or B will be non-NA → returns that value.
# New format (v2): A and B are NA → falls through to the single-slider value.
coalesce_val3 <- function(a, b, single) {
  coalesce(coalesce_val(a, b), suppressWarnings(as.numeric(single)))
}

# Record which slider was presented first (v1 only; NA for v2 participants).
slider_order_flag <- function(a, b) {
  case_when(
    !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(a))) ~ "valence_first",
    !is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(b))) ~ "valence_second",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# Detect experiment version per participant.
# v1: has data in the A-slider column; v2: that column is always NA.
format_map <- raw_task |>
  group_by(participant_id) |>
  summarise(
    data_version = if_else(
      any(!is.na(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`momentary_valence_slider_A.response`)))),
      "v1_pilot", "v2_jul"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("Format by participant:\n")
print(format_map)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## 4. Extract each event type

Each section below:

1.  **Identifies** rows using prefixed indicator columns (unchanged between versions).
2.  **Extracts** responses using `coalesce_val3` for valence (A → B → single) and directly for arousal (column name unchanged).

### 4.1 Condition order (one row per participant)

```{r cond-order}
cond_order <- raw_task |>
  filter(!is.na(conditionOrder) & conditionOrder != "") |>
  distinct(participant_id, conditionOrder)
```

### 4.2 Pre-baseline momentary ratings

```{r pre-baseline}
pre_bl <- raw_task |>
  filter(!is.na(`pre_baseline_ratings.momentary_arousal_slider.response`)) |>
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    prebl_valence = coalesce_val3(
      `momentary_valence_slider_A.response`,
      `momentary_valence_slider_B.response`,
      `momentary_valence_slider.response`
    ),
    prebl_valence_rt = coalesce_val3(
      `momentary_valence_slider_A.rt`,
      `momentary_valence_slider_B.rt`,
      `momentary_valence_slider.rt`
    ),
    prebl_valence_slider_order = slider_order_flag(
      `momentary_valence_slider_A.response`,
      `momentary_valence_slider_B.response`
    ),
    prebl_arousal    = as.numeric(`momentary_arousal_slider.response`),
    prebl_arousal_rt = as.numeric(`momentary_arousal_slider.rt`)
  )
```

### 4.3 Post-baseline momentary ratings

```{r post-baseline}
post_bl <- raw_task |>
  filter(!is.na(`post_baseline_ratings.momentary_arousal_slider.response`)) |>
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    postbl_valence = coalesce_val3(
      `momentary_valence_slider_A.response`,
      `momentary_valence_slider_B.response`,
      `momentary_valence_slider.response`
    ),
    postbl_valence_rt = coalesce_val3(
      `momentary_valence_slider_A.rt`,
      `momentary_valence_slider_B.rt`,
      `momentary_valence_slider.rt`
    ),
    postbl_valence_slider_order = slider_order_flag(
      `momentary_valence_slider_A.response`,
      `momentary_valence_slider_B.response`
    ),
    postbl_arousal    = as.numeric(`momentary_arousal_slider.response`),
    postbl_arousal_rt = as.numeric(`momentary_arousal_slider.rt`)
  )
```

```{r post-induction}

```

### 4.5 Post-recovery momentary ratings

```{r post-recovery}
post_rec <- raw_task |>
  filter(!is.na(`post_emotion_recovery_ratings.momentary_arousal_slider.response`)) |>
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    condition,
    postrec_valence = coalesce_val3(
```

### 4.6 Per-video stimulus ratings

`trigger_name` and `origional_video_id` are on different raw rows in the PsychoPy output. We build a lookup keyed on the filename stem and join it in.

The v2 format renamed the stim valence sliders to a single `stim_valence_slider`; `stim_arousal_slider` and `stim_approach_slider` are unchanged.

```{r trigger-lookup}
trigger_lookup <- raw_task |>
  filter(!is.na(trigger_name) & trigger_name != "" &
         !is.na(stim_path)    & stim_path    != "") |>
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    video_id     = str_remove(basename(stim_path), "\\.[^.]+$"),
    trigger_name
  )
```

```{r stim-ratings}
stim_ratings <- raw_task |>
  filter(!is.na(origional_video_id) & origional_video_id != "") |>
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    video_id  = origional_video_id,
    condition = case_when(
      str_starts(origional_video_id, "P") ~ "positive",
      str_starts(origional_video_id, "N") ~ "negative",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    stim_valence = coalesce_val3(
      `stim_valence_slider_A.response`,
      `stim_valence_slider_B.response`,
      `stim_valence_slider.response`
    ),
    stim_valence_rt = coalesce_val3(
      `stim_valence_slider_A.rt`,
      `stim_valence_slider_B.rt`,
      `stim_valence_slider.rt`
    ),
    stim_valence_slider_order = slider_order_flag(
      `stim_valence_slider_A.response`,
      `stim_valence_slider_B.response`
    ),
    stim_arousal    = as.numeric(`stim_arousal_slider.response`),
    stim_arousal_rt = as.numeric(`stim_arousal_slider.rt`),
    stim_approach    = as.numeric(`stim_approach_slider.response`),
    stim_approach_rt = as.numeric(`stim_approach_slider.rt`),
    stim_emotion_label = emotionText.text,
    stim_emotion_intensity = intensitySlider.response,
    stim_emotion_intensity_rt = intensitySlider.rt
  ) |>
  left_join(trigger_lookup, by = c("participant_id", "video_id"))
```

## 5. Join into one row per video per subject

```{r join}
clean_data <- stim_ratings |>
  left_join(post_ind,   by = c("participant_id", "condition")) |>
  left_join(post_rec,   by = c("participant_id", "condition")) |>
  left_join(pre_bl,     by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(post_bl,    by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(cond_order, by = "participant_id") |>
  left_join(format_map, by = "participant_id") |>
  mutate(
    condition_rank = case_when(
      conditionOrder == "pos_first" & condition == "positive" ~ 1L,
      conditionOrder == "pos_first" & condition == "negative" ~ 2L,
      conditionOrder == "neg_first" & condition == "negative" ~ 1L,
      conditionOrder == "neg_first" & condition == "positive" ~ 2L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(participant_id, condition_rank) |>
  select(-condition_rank) |>
  select(
    participant_id, data_version, conditionOrder, condition, video_id, trigger_name,
    # Stimulus ratings
    stim_valence, stim_valence_rt, stim_valence_slider_order,
    stim_arousal, stim_arousal_rt,
    stim_approach, stim_approach_rt,
    stim_emotion_label,
    stim_emotion_intensity,
    stim_emotion_intensity_rt,
    # Post-induction momentary
    postind_valence, postind_valence_rt, postind_valence_slider_order,
    postind_arousal, postind_arousal_rt,
    # Post-recovery momentary
    postrec_valence, postrec_valence_rt, postrec_valence_slider_order,
    postrec_arousal, postrec_arousal_rt,
    # Pre-baseline momentary
    prebl_valence,  prebl_valence_rt,  prebl_valence_slider_order,
    prebl_arousal,  prebl_arousal_rt,
    # Post-baseline momentary
    postbl_valence, postbl_valence_rt, postbl_valence_slider_order,
    postbl_arousal, postbl_arousal_rt,
 
  )

cat("Final rows   :", nrow(clean_data), "\n")
cat("Final columns:", ncol(clean_data), "\n")
cat("Rows/subject :", nrow(clean_data) / n_distinct(clean_data$participant_id), "\n")
cat("\nParticipants by version:\n")
count(clean_data, participant_id, data_version) |> print()
```

## 6. Manipulation check columns

```{r manip-check}
clean_data <- clean_data |>
  mutate(
    manip_check_valence = postind_valence - postbl_valence,
    manip_check_arousal = postind_arousal - postbl_arousal,
    manip_check_direction_correct = case_when(
      condition == "positive" & manip_check_valence > 0 ~ TRUE,
      condition == "negative" & manip_check_valence < 0 ~ TRUE,
      is.na(manip_check_valence)                        ~ NA,
      TRUE                                              ~ FALSE
    )
  )
```

## 9. Concatenate and apply condition labels to Biometrics data

```{r}
## --- Biometrics: assign experimental condition labels ---

# Step 1: Per-participant clock offset (PsychoPy internal → biometrics recording clock)
# offset = time_since_recording_start − thisRow.t  ≈ 0.59 s, stable within session
clock_offset <- raw_task |>
  filter(!is.na(time_since_recording_start), !is.na(`thisRow.t`)) |>
  mutate(
    psychopy_t  = as.numeric(`thisRow.t`),
    bio_t       = as.numeric(time_since_recording_start),
    offset      = bio_t - psychopy_t
  ) |>
  filter(abs(offset) < 10) |>   # drop anomalous rows (e.g. offset = −179 s)
  group_by(participant_id) |>
  summarise(clock_offset_s = median(offset, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

cat("Clock offsets per participant:\n")
print(clock_offset)

# Step 2: Extract event windows from task data (PsychoPy clock → convert to bio clock)
# Baseline window
baseline_windows <- raw_task |>
  filter(!is.na(`baseline.started`)) |>
  left_join(clock_offset, by = "participant_id") |>
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    phase     = "baseline",
    condition = NA_character_,
    video_id  = NA_character_,
    start_bio = as.numeric(`baseline.started`) + clock_offset_s,
    end_bio   = as.numeric(`baseline.stopped`)  + clock_offset_s
  )

# Stimulus windows (condition inferred from stim_path)
stimulus_windows <- raw_task |>
  filter(!is.na(`stimuli.started`), !is.na(stim_path), stim_path != "") |>
  left_join(clock_offset, by = "participant_id") |>
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    phase     = "stimulus",
    condition = case_when(
      str_detect(stim_path, "/P|/p") ~ "positive",
      str_detect(stim_path, "/N|/n") ~ "negative",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    video_id  = str_remove(basename(stim_path), "\\.[^.]+$"),
    start_bio = as.numeric(`stimuli.started`) + clock_offset_s,
    end_bio   = as.numeric(`stimuli.stopped`)  + clock_offset_s
  )

# Recovery windows — condition carried from the condition column on those rows
recovery_windows <- raw_task |>
  filter(!is.na(`stim_recovery.started`)) |>
  left_join(clock_offset, by = "participant_id") |>
  transmute(
    participant_id,
    phase     = "recovery",
    condition,
    video_id  = NA_character_,
    start_bio = as.numeric(`stim_recovery.started`) + clock_offset_s,
    end_bio   = as.numeric(`stim_recovery.stopped`)  + clock_offset_s
  )

event_windows <- bind_rows(baseline_windows, stimulus_windows, recovery_windows) |>
  filter(!is.na(start_bio), !is.na(end_bio))

cat("\nEvent windows:\n")
print(event_windows)

# Step 3: Range-join biometrics rows to event windows
# Each biometrics row gets labelled with whichever phase window its `time` falls in.
# Rows outside all windows (e.g. ratings screens, instructions) get phase = NA.
raw_biometrics_labelled <- raw_biometrics |>
  mutate(time = as.numeric(time)) |>
  left_join(
    event_windows,
    by = join_by(participant_id, between(time, start_bio, end_bio))
  ) |>
  select(-start_bio, -end_bio)|>
  relocate(participant_id, phase, condition, video_id)
  
cat("\nBiometrics rows by phase:\n")
count(raw_biometrics_labelled, participant_id, phase, condition) |> print()
```

## 10. Update condition labelling 

```{r}
cond_levels <- c("baseline", "negative_induction", "post_negative_induction_recovery",
                 "positive_induction", "post_positive_induction_recovery")

# Biometrics ------------------------------------------------------------------
raw_biometrics_labelled <- raw_biometrics_labelled |>
  mutate(
    condition = factor(case_when(
      phase == "baseline"                            ~ "baseline",
      phase == "stimulus" & condition == "negative"  ~ "negative_induction",
      phase == "recovery" & condition == "negative"  ~ "post_negative_recovery",
      phase == "stimulus" & condition == "positive"  ~ "positive_induction",
      phase == "recovery" & condition == "positive"  ~ "post_positive_recovery",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ), levels = cond_levels)
  ) |>
  select(-phase)

# Task data -------------------------------------------------------------------
baseline_rows <- clean_data |>
  distinct(participant_id, conditionOrder, data_version, postbl_valence, postbl_arousal) |>
  transmute(participant_id, conditionOrder, data_version,
            condition = "baseline", video_id = NA_character_, trigger_name = NA_character_,
            block_end_valence = postbl_valence, block_end_arousal = postbl_arousal,
            stim_valence = NA_real_, stim_valence_rt = NA_real_,
            stim_arousal = NA_real_, stim_arousal_rt = NA_real_,
            stim_approach = NA_real_, stim_approach_rt = NA_real_,
            stim_emotion_label = NA_character_,
            stim_emotion_intensity = NA_real_, stim_emotion_intensity_rt = NA_real_)

negative_rows <- clean_data |>
  filter(condition == "negative") |>
  transmute(participant_id, conditionOrder, data_version,
            condition = "negative_induction", video_id, trigger_name,
            block_end_valence = postind_valence, block_end_arousal = postind_arousal,
            stim_valence, stim_valence_rt, stim_arousal, stim_arousal_rt,
            stim_approach, stim_approach_rt,
            stim_emotion_label, stim_emotion_intensity, stim_emotion_intensity_rt)

post_neg_rows <- clean_data |>
  filter(condition == "negative") |>
  distinct(participant_id, conditionOrder, data_version, postrec_valence, postrec_arousal) |>
  transmute(participant_id, conditionOrder, data_version,
            condition = "post_negative_induction_recovery", video_id = NA_character_, trigger_name = NA_character_,
            block_end_valence = postrec_valence, block_end_arousal = postrec_arousal,
            stim_valence = NA_real_, stim_valence_rt = NA_real_,
            stim_arousal = NA_real_, stim_arousal_rt = NA_real_,
            stim_approach = NA_real_, stim_approach_rt = NA_real_,
            stim_emotion_label = NA_character_,
            stim_emotion_intensity = NA_real_, stim_emotion_intensity_rt = NA_real_)

positive_rows <- clean_data |>
  filter(condition == "positive") |>
  transmute(participant_id, conditionOrder, data_version,
            condition = "positive_induction", video_id, trigger_name,
            block_end_valence = postind_valence, block_end_arousal = postind_arousal,
            stim_valence, stim_valence_rt, stim_arousal, stim_arousal_rt,
            stim_approach, stim_approach_rt,
            stim_emotion_label, stim_emotion_intensity, stim_emotion_intensity_rt)

post_pos_rows <- clean_data |>
  filter(condition == "positive") |>
  distinct(participant_id, conditionOrder, data_version, postrec_valence, postrec_arousal) |>
  transmute(participant_id, conditionOrder, data_version,
            condition = "post_positive_induction_recovery", video_id = NA_character_, trigger_name = NA_character_,
            block_end_valence = postrec_valence, block_end_arousal = postrec_arousal,
            stim_valence = NA_real_, stim_valence_rt = NA_real_,
            stim_arousal = NA_real_, stim_arousal_rt = NA_real_,
            stim_approach = NA_real_, stim_approach_rt = NA_real_,
            stim_emotion_label = NA_character_,
            stim_emotion_intensity = NA_real_, stim_emotion_intensity_rt = NA_real_)

clean_data_long <- bind_rows(baseline_rows, negative_rows, post_neg_rows,
                             positive_rows, post_pos_rows) |>
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = cond_levels)) |>
  relocate(participant_id, condition, video_id) |>
  arrange(participant_id, condition)

count(clean_data_long, condition)
```

## 11. Filter out data that isn't needed for subsequent analysis and save

```{r}
raw_biometrics_labelled <- raw_biometrics_labelled |>
  filter(!is.na(condition))

clean_data_long <- clean_data_long |>
  select(-conditionOrder,-data_version,)

dir.create(clean_data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

out_path <- file.path(clean_data_dir, "biosignals2_selfreport_ratings.csv")
write_csv(clean_data_long, out_path)
cat("Saved:", out_path, "\n")

out_path <- file.path(clean_data_dir, "biosignals2_webcambiometrics.csv")
write_csv(raw_biometrics_labelled, out_path)
cat("Saved:", out_path, "\n")
```

## 9. Counterbalancing tracker

```{r counterbalance}
cb <- clean_data |>
  distinct(participant_id, conditionOrder) |>
  count(conditionOrder, name = "n_participants")

n_total    <- sum(cb$n_participants)
n_groups   <- nrow(cb)
is_balanced <- n_groups > 1 && length(unique(cb$n_participants)) == 1

cat("Total participants   :", n_total, "\n")
cat("Condition orders seen:", paste(cb$conditionOrder, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Balanced             :", is_balanced, "\n\n")

cb |>
  mutate(
    pct      = round(100 * n_participants / n_total),
    balanced = if_else(is_balanced, "✓", "⚠ unequal groups")
  ) |>
  kable(caption = "Participants per counterbalancing group")
```

```{r counterbalance-plot}
clean_data |>
  distinct(participant_id, conditionOrder, data_version) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = conditionOrder, fill = data_version)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = after_stat(count)),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4, colour = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(v1_pilot = "#5B8DB8", v2_jul = "#E07B54")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)),
                     breaks = scales::breaks_width(1)) +
  labs(title = "Counterbalancing: participants per condition order",
       x = NULL, y = "N participants", fill = "Data version") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```
